title: AttachmentGallery Component

name.description: Unique name identifier for the gallery

items.description: Already loaded records shown as is, no query is made: an array or a single-chunk template resolving to one, e.g. '{{ photos }}'

query.description: GraphQL query that loads the records: a grid's '{{ gqlCommand.query }}'. Ignored when items is set

variables.description: Query variables: a grid's '{{ gqlCommand.variables }}'. The gallery first loads the page skip/take point at (take defaults to options.pageSize), then pages through the whole result with its own skip/take; the records are read from the first result field's items and totalCount

currentAttachmentId.description: attachmentId of the record to open first. Not found → the first record (with a query: the first record of the loaded page)

urlField.description: Record field with the file URL to show. Default presignedFileUri

fileNameField.description: Record field with the file name. Default fileName

pageSize.description: Paged mode: records kept loaded on each side of the current one, and how many more are loaded at once when the user goes past them. Default 10

permission.description: Permission(s) required to render the component: a permission string or an array of permission strings

description: Web only. Lightbox over a list of files: the current file (images; PDFs through the viewer), prev/next arrows and keys, an 'n / N' counter, a thumbnail strip and Download. Records come from items, or from query + variables — with a grid's gqlCommand it shows everything the grid's filter, search and sort match, not just the grid page.
